headline: Rare pink-zebra seaweed confirmed as new species
summary: A seaweed fragment found in Cornwall after a 40-year search has been DNA-tested and will join the Natural History Museum collection.
script: A tiny pink-striped seaweed found in Cornwall has finally been confirmed as a new species, after a scientist searched for it for four decades. It will join the Natural History Museum collection and help document fragile maerl habitats.
